PC: Asked about family history of alcohol or drug problems (e.g. mother, father).
Asked what pain medications patient has used.
Asked pain level when taking medication as prescribed.
Asked if ever taken more medication than prescribed.
Asked if has ever been over-sedated (put to sleep or knocked out) from pain medication.
Asked about scripts from more than one doctor.
Asked about legal problems due to alcohol or drugs (i.e., drink/drive).
Asked patient if willing to take a urine drug screening.
Stated will prescribe or not prescribe.
SBP: Asked permission to request records from past physician.
